resources.string: The Control Center, picture diagnostics and the gaming HUD over any app or console. Hold Home for the Control Center (sound, Wi-Fi, profiles, sleep timer, power). Hold Up and Down together for 2 seconds for the picture, Left and Right for the HUD. It watches only the remote\'s buttons and which app is in front, and reads nothing on the screen.
Presses Connect on the TV\'s Bluetooth page when you connect a device from Neon Home, then turns itself off.
A crash report has been sent to help us fix this issue.
